paragraphs.text: Balloon is a token creature type for the prizes given out at Attractions .

A balloon is a rubber bag that is inflated with air and then sealed at the neck, used as a child's toy or a decoration. Several balloons may be twisted, shaped, and connected in the form of an animal.
Balloon debuted as a creature type in Unfinity . Balloons were first referenced on an eternal card in Unfinity , and in a premier set in Duskmourn: House of Horror .
Currently, only tokens have the Balloon subtype.
